name: Gasthaus Bergheim
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Bergheim in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, **Gasthaus Bergheim** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy mountain setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse offers a warm retreat after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**.

Indulge in traditional Tyrolean cuisine, where every dish is crafted with local ingredients. Start your day with a hearty breakfast featuring fresh bread, homemade jams, and regional cheeses. For lunch or dinner, savor classics like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a hearty **Kaspressknödel**—all paired with crisp **Tiroler Bier** or smooth **Grüner Veltliner**.

The rooms at **Gasthaus Bergheim** blend rustic charm with modern comforts, ensuring a peaceful night’s sleep. Whether you’re hiking the **Zillertal Alps**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or simply unwinding with a book by the fireplace, this is your perfect home base in **Tirol**.

**Come and experience the warmth of Tyrol—where every visit feels like coming home.**
